profile.visual_desc: A winged reptilian humanoid in layered blue and red robes. Features large dark blue wings, grey pauldrons, and a wide flat hat. Scaly grey skin is visible beneath the garments.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a reptilian profile with a piercing red eye and sharp teeth. A flat hat casts a heavy shadow over the scaly brow.
profile.weapon_desc: Concentrated solar energy orb channeled from the chest.
profile.step1_ready: Standing front-isometric facing down-right. A swirling golden energy ring manifests in front of the torso.
profile.step2_windup: The energy ring compresses into a small, dense spiral and then into a brilliant solid yellow orb.
profile.step3_impact: Discharges a thick, elongated golden energy beam projecting toward the bottom-right of the frame.
profile.step4_finish: The beam dissipates into a small fading spark as the mage returns to a neutral upright stance with wings spread.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy beam in Frame 4 originates from the chest and extends exactly along the down-right diagonal trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation accurately mirrors the reference sequence. Biomechanics and VFX trajectory align with the original source.
